item.title: 5 arrested, 5 wanted in Baton Rouge area fraudulent check scheme
item.description: Five suspects were arrested, and five are wanted in connection with a Baton Rouge area scheme involving the cashing of $10,000 using fraudulent checks.

item.title: FEMA sends $3.79M in upfront emergency funding to Louisiana after winter storm
item.description: FEMA is providing $3.79 million in emergency funding to Louisiana to help the state quickly respond to the recent severe winter storm, covering costs such as generators, debris removal, and emergency shelters.

item.title: 'You're going to jail': Video shows Olympic track star Sha'Carri Richardson's 'super speeder' arrest in Florida
item.description: Body camera video released Friday shows a deputy pulling over Olympic track star Sha’Carri Richardson before she was arrested on Florida's 'super speeder" law.

item.title: Four candidates qualify for Louisiana House District 69 special election
item.description: Four candidates have qualified for the 69th Representative District Seat for the March 14 election, covering East Baton Rouge Parish, after Rep. Paula Davis resigned.

item.title: REPORT: LSU athlete under investigation, accused of violating Name, Image, and Likeness rule
item.description: LSU is reportedly under investigation due to a Name, Image, and Likeness (NIL) violation, reports say.

item.title: LSU softball prepares for the 2026 season with a new roster
item.description: Beth Torina enters her 15th season as the head coach of LSU softball with a roster that features 11 new players, the most newcomers in program history. Five are coming from the transfer portal and six from the incoming high school class. Within the transfer portal class, three are coming from SEC programs

item.title: St. Vincent de Paul keeps shelter open as temperatures drop
item.description: St. Vincent de Paul of Baton Rouge is keeping its warming shelter open this weekend due to the dangerously low temperatures forecasted, providing overnight shelter, warmth, and meals as capacity allows.

item.title: Baton Rouge activists, groups protest against recent immigration crackdowns
item.description: Dozens of protesters gathered at the corner of Essen and Perkins Road in Baton Rouge on Friday to demand justice for the killings of Rene Goode and Alex Petit. The demonstrators called for accountability and an end to violent crackdowns by federal agents across the country.

item.title: 5 escapees in custody after multiple inmates reported missing from North Louisiana detention center
item.description: Three escapees were captured while a search is ongoing for five inmates in North Louisiana, according to the Louisiana State Police.
